# Heart Radio

> Heart Radio is the UK's leading commercial radio station delivering entertainment, celebrity news, music, and lifestyle content with live streaming via Global Player.

Heart Radio combines traditional radio broadcasting with digital content across entertainment, showbiz, news, and lifestyle. The station features popular presenters like JK and Kelly Brook, offers podcasts and live playlists, and runs community initiatives like the Make Some Noise charity campaign.

## Key Topics

- Heart Radio
- Global Player
- Celebrity News
- UK Radio
- Showbiz & Entertainment
- Live Streaming
- Radio Shows & Presenters
- Music News
- Reality TV (MAFS)
- Podcasts
- Weather Forecast

- Lifestyle Content
- Make Some Noise Charity
- Trending Content

## Radio & On-Demand

- [Heart Radio Homepage](https://www.heart.co.uk): Heart Radio homepage with celebrity news, competitions, and streaming via Global Player
- [JK and Kelly Brook Show](https://www.heart.co.uk/radio/shows-presenters/jk-and-kelly): JK and Kelly Brook's weekday afternoon radio show on Heart
- [Last Played Songs](https://www.heart.co.uk/radio/last-played-songs): Live playlist showing last played songs on Heart Radio
- [Heart Podcasts](https://www.heart.co.uk/podcasts): Heart podcast directory with free downloads via Global Player

## Entertainment & Celebrity News

- [Showbiz & TV News](https://www.heart.co.uk/showbiz): Celebrity news, TV updates, gossip and exclusive interviews on Heart FM
- [Music News](https://www.heart.co.uk/showbiz/music): Latest music news, videos and releases from top artists and bands
- [Married at First Sight Coverage](https://www.heart.co.uk/showbiz/tv-movies/married-at-first-sight): MAFS Australia and UK coverage with news, videos and photo galleries
- [Taylor Swift News](https://www.heart.co.uk/showbiz/celebrities/taylor-swift): Taylor Swift news coverage including Eras Tour and celebrity updates

## News & Information

- [Breaking News](https://www.heart.co.uk/news): Breaking UK and world news with pictures and videos from Heart
- [Weather Forecast](https://www.heart.co.uk/news/weather): 7-day UK weather forecast with alerts and temperature data

## Lifestyle & Events

- [Lifestyle](https://www.heart.co.uk/lifestyle): Women's lifestyle content covering beauty, fashion, relationships and travel
- [UK Events Guide](https://www.heart.co.uk/events): UK events guide with concert tickets, tour dates, festivals and Race for Life

## Community & Charity

- [Make Some Noise Charity](https://www.heart.co.uk/radio/charity): Make Some Noise charity campaign supporting UK charities via Heart

## Optional

- [Heart Merchandise Store](https://www.heart.co.uk/store): Heart branded merchandise store with apparel, homeware and accessories
